//: Reference of every setting the app reads. Do not put real secrets in this file: use User Secrets locally and App Service application settings in Azure (nested keys become App__BaseUrl, Stripe__SecretKey and so on).

App.GoogleAnalyticsId: optional: G-XXXXXXXXXX, loads Google Analytics when set
App.SweepIntervalMinutes: optional: minutes between background sweeps, default 15

Storage.AzureBlobConnectionString: required only when Provider is AzureBlob
Storage.LocalRootPath: optional: folder for Local uploads outside wwwroot, e.g. /home/data/uploads on App Service

Email.ResendApiKey: required only when Provider is Resend

Demo.SellerStripeAccountId: acct_... (Stripe test-mode connected account, required when Enabled)
Demo.ResetIntervalDays: optional: days between demo resets, default 7

Seed.AdminEmail: optional: first admin account, created on startup
